clients.name: Brindle & Daw Lettings
clients.about: Estate agents with four branches and a fondness for matching desks.
asks: We are refitting the branches and would like one of these on every desk. Could you quote for the lot?
Head office saw yours online and now everybody wants one. Same for all of us, please.
We give these to new tenants with the keys. We've run out again.

clients.name: Mosswick Garden Centre
clients.about: A garden centre with a gift shop bigger than the garden part.
asks: These would fly off the shelf by our tills. Can you do us a boxful at a trade price?
A coach party cleaned us out. We need restocking before the weekend after next.
We are putting together a gift table. Yours would sit nicely on it.

clients.name: The Tabletop Tavern
clients.about: A board game café that loses more pieces than it sells coffees.
asks: We want one of these on every table for the tournament. They will get borrowed, so make them sturdy.
Our regulars keep asking where we got ours. We'd like to sell them behind the bar.
Prizes for league night. Nothing too fancy, just all the same.

clients.name: Larkhill Primary School
clients.about: A school with a small budget, a long term and a great many children.
asks: One for each child in Year 4, please. There is no rush, but there are a lot of them.
The parents' association has raised the money. Could we have a class set?
Ours have all gone missing over the summer, as they do every summer.

clients.name: Cogwright Engineering
clients.about: A machine shop down the road. They measure everything, including yours.
asks: We need these on the shop floor, so they have to take a knock. Strong, and on time, and we will pay for both.
The supplier let us down. If yours hold up, there will be more work.
For the fitters' benches. They break everything, so build them properly.

clients.name: Harrow Hospitality Group
clients.about: Six restaurants and a hotel, all under one very particular manager.
asks: We are opening a new site and need every table dressed the same. Our designer has sent the file.
The old ones have gone sticky. Replacements for all of them, please, before the inspection.
For the function room. It has to look like it was all bought together.

clients.name: Wexcombe Museum Trust
clients.about: A small town museum that lets children handle the exhibits, or copies of them.
asks: For the handling table. The children will drop them, so we would like a few to spare.
A touring exhibition is coming and each school group gets one to pass round.
The gift shop sold out of the last lot in a week, to the trustees' surprise.
